Good questions.

Instead of a trial, every new account gets 200 free credits to use on any ARINE tool. When they run out, choose a plan or buy a top-up.

Each plan gives you a set number of credits every month. When you need more, buy a top-up pack or choose a custom amount.

Pay yearly and get one month free. For example, Growth is ₹1,09,989 a year instead of ₹1,19,988.

Some plans include bonus credits on top of the base credits, added every month.

Choose a pack or any amount from ₹1,000 to ₹5,00,000. Custom top-ups give 0.5 credits per rupee.
